questions: Are adjacent swaps allowed only between adjacent positions, or can we swap any two positions with a series of adjacent swaps (i.e., bubble sort moves)?
If there are multiple groups of 1s, must they merge into a single contiguous block, or is it acceptable to have multiple separate contiguous blocks of 1s as long as each block itself is contiguous?
Is the goal to minimize total swaps across all 1s, or can we consider swapping 0s as well to achieve contiguity?
When multiple 1s are moved, do we count each adjacent swap separately, even if swapping the same pair multiple times?
Are we allowed to swap characters that are both 0 or both 1, or should swaps only involve a 0 and a 1 to be useful?

Does the minimal number of operations depend on which contiguous block of 1s we choose as the target, or is any contiguous block acceptable as long as it's minimal across all possible final positions?
If there are no 1s in the string, is the condition vacuously true (all 1s are contiguous because there are none), and thus the answer is 0?
Is the string 1-indexed or 0-indexed for the operation and contiguity definition?
